To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
lubricating oil film between the piston ring-liner interface can vary between 0 and 8 mm and it varies significantly in upward & downward strokes of the engine.

the capacitance based oil film thickness measurement is a very effective technique and can be directly employed for measurement of lubricating film thickness between piston and liner in a firing engine.
the oil film thickness varies between 0.3 to 8.2 μm in a motored four stroke engine.
In summary, our research is concerned with
development of an accurate and reliable method of measuring oil film thickness between the piston ring liner in an internal combustion engine.
the measurement of lubricating film thickness between piston rings and cylinder liners in a motored four stroke single cylinder diesel engine.
the development of a novel capacitive micro sensor to measure the dynamic lubricating oil thickness at the piston-ring liner interface in internal combustion engine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present capacitive micro sensor is capable of measuring the dynamic lubricating oil thickness in an internal combustion engine and it can be used to measure oil film thickness in an engine with different lubricants and at different engine speeds.

the present investigations provide an accurate measurement of minimum oil thickness between piston ring liner interfaces and the sensor and instrumentation can be directly used for measurement of lubricating film thickness in a firing engine.
the capacitance method is a reliable and accurate method for measurement of lubricating film thickness at the interface between the piston ring liner in an engine.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the sensor and instrumentation developed in this work is capable of accurately measuring oil film thickness between the piston ring liner interfaces in motored engine.
the sensor is capable of measuring oil film thickness in the engine with a high degree of accuracy and repeatability and the instrumentation is simple, reliable and robust.

this sensor and instrumentation is capable of measuring the lubricating oil film between piston ring and cylinder liner with high accuracy and it can be used to investigate the effect of different operating parameters on lubricating oil film formation and its variation with speed and location.

the oil film thickness is not uniform in the upward and downward stroke at a given crank angle position.
the sensor can be used for measuring lubricating oil film in a motored or firing engine and it can also be used for studying piston ring liner wear and friction in a firing engine.
